uploaded_cases.title: Search 'portable ssd 1tb', open first non-sponsored product, verify title and price, add to cart and verify confirmation
uploaded_cases.preconditions: Clean (fresh) browser session: no cookies, no stored state, no logged-in Amazon account. No items in cart (fresh context implies cart count is 0 / absent). Desktop viewport (default Playwright chromium project settings). Blocking condition (applies to every step): if at any point a CAPTCHA, robot-check, or consent interstitial is presented, the test MUST fail immediately with a BLOCKED status/annotation; these interstitials must NEVER be bypassed, solved, or clicked through. Requirement traceability: REQ-AMZ-04 (extracted_requirements.json, 'Search for Portable SSD and Add to Cart'). Target URL: https://amazon.in. Target spec file: e2e/amazon/portable-ssd-1tb-pdp.spec.ts (Playwright project: chromium).

steps.expected: Amazon.in home page loads. The search box is visible: getByRole('searchbox', { name: 'Search Amazon.in' }). No CAPTCHA/robot-check/consent interstitial (otherwise BLOCKED).

steps.step: Click the search box, type 'portable ssd 1tb', and submit by pressing Enter.
steps.expected: Search results page loads. URL matches /\/s\?.*k=portable(\+|%20)ssd(\+|%20)1tb/i (case-insensitive). At least one result card is present: [data-component-type="s-search-result"].

steps.step: Locate the first non-sponsored result: page.locator('[data-component-type="s-search-result"]').filter({ hasNotText: 'Sponsored' }).first(), then click its product link a:has(h2). Note: the link may open a popup (target=_blank) — handle via popup promise and continue on the new page if one opens.
steps.expected: Product detail page (PDP) opens (in same tab or popup). PDP URL matches /\/dp\//.

steps.step: On the PDP, verify the product title.
steps.expected: #productTitle is visible and its text content is non-empty.

steps.step: On the PDP, verify the product price.
steps.expected: #corePriceDisplay_desktop_feature_div .a-price-whole is visible and contains digits; the ₹ symbol is present in the price block. Do NOT use .a-offscreen for price assertions.

steps.step: Click the Add to Cart button: getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to cart', exact: true }).
steps.expected: Button is visible/enabled and the click succeeds without error.

One of: an 'Added to cart' confirmation message / cart side-sheet appears, OR the cart count indicator increments to 1. ⚠️ UNVERIFIED selector: the exact confirmation selector ('Added to cart' message, cart side-sheet, or cart count badge) has NOT been verified against the live site and MUST be verified live before generating the final assertions in e2e/amazon/portable-ssd-1tb-pdp.spec.ts.
